sources.summary: MAP (Movement Advancement Project) equality-map page cataloguing state bans on transgender people's use of public bathrooms and facilities according to their gender identity; the dossier cites it for Iowa's enacted facility ban and the 18-state group defining sex as biological sex (Iowa not among the states listed there as defining sex by birth in statute). NOTE: URL returned a 404 at fetch time (MAP has moved the page).

Erin In The Morning, 'Anti-Trans National Legal Risk Assessment Map: July 2026' (Stonewall News, published 27 Aug 2026): a per-state legal-risk grading of anti-trans law. The adult map lists 'Do Not Travel (FL, ID, KS, TX)' and 'The Worst States (AL, AR, IA, IN, LA, MS, OH, OK, ND, SC, SD, TN, UT, WV, WY)' - this state is in the worst group. The update records Idaho's promotion to 'Do Not Travel' as the fourth such state after its felony bathroom ban (up to 5 years; partially court-blocked but in force wherever no gender-neutral option exists), Kansas's bounty-hunter civil-suit regime, and a national frame of 'Worst Policies In Effect'.

'Safe states don't make safer people' (The Needle, July 2026): data essay overlaying the state legal-risk map on Trans Murder Monitoring killings data - legal-risk grades predict how the state behaves, not how people behave toward trans people; every count is an undercount; rates do not line up with the map. Cited as interpretive context for reading a state's mid-map legal-risk position (Iowa not named in the fetched text).
